parameters{
	EndDate as timestamp (),
	EndDateFilter as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	ExportFolder as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_FATAL as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_INFO as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_NBR_WARNING as integer (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_COMPLETE as string (),
	LOGMESSAGE_TEXT_PROCESS_START as string (),
	MedicareExportFile as string (),
	MedicareTemplateFile as string (),
	StartDate as timestamp (),
	StartDateFilter as string (),
	TemplateFile as string (),
	Variable as integer ()
}

source(output(
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID as string,
		LIST as string,
		CALLLISTDATE_DATE as timestamp,
		CALLLISTRULE_CD as string,
		CALLLISTRULE_DESC as string,
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_EFF_DT as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'DECLARE @P_STARTDATE DATETIME, @P_ENDDATE DATETIME, @STARTDATE DATETIME, @ENDDATE DATETIME  SET @P_STARTDATE = ? SET @P_ENDDATE = ?  IF @P_ENDDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @ENDDATE = GETDATE() ELSE 	SET @ENDDATE = @P_ENDDATE  IF @P_STARTDATE = \'1/1/1901\' 	SET @STARTDATE = DATEADD(DAY,-7,@ENDDATE) ELSE 	SET @STARTDATE = @P_STARTDATE  SELECT DISTINCT AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID,AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_EFF_DT,\'SIMPLY MEDICARE\' AS LIST,CALLLISTDATE_DATE,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD,ICR.CALLLISTRULE_DESC FROM PDS_CALLLIST CL 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTDATE CD ON CL.CALLLIST_IID = CD.CALLLISTDATE_CALLLIST_IID 		AND CL.CALLLIST_CD = \'703\' 		AND CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE BETWEEN @STARTDATE AND @ENDDATE 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTMASTER CM ON CD.CALLLISTDATE_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_CALLLISTDATE_IID 	INNER JOIN PDS_CALLLISTRULE ICR ON CM.CALLLISTMASTER_INACTIVE_CALLLISTRULE_IID = ICR.CALLLISTRULE_IID 		AND ICR.CALLLISTRULE_CD NOT IN (\'DELDISPOSITIONS\',\'DELXATTEMPTS\') 	INNER JOIN PDS_AFFILIATE_MEMBER AM ON AM.AFFILIATE_MEMBER_IID = CM.CALLLISTMASTER_ENTITY_IID	 ORDER BY CD.CALLLISTDATE_DATE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> PDS703MembersScrubbed
PDS703MembersScrubbed derive(LIST_Unicode = LIST,
		CALLLISTRULE_DESC_Unicode = CALLLISTRULE_DESC,
		CALLLISTRULE_CD_Unicode = CALLLISTRULE_CD,
		AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID_Unicode = AFFILIATE_MEMBER_AFFILIATEMEMBERID) ~> ConverttoUnicode
